name: telethon-plus
description: HTTP + MCP control plane over a real Telegram MTProto userbot (Telethon) — send/read/edit/delete/forward messages, dialogs, entities, media, chat admin, and polls, plus an incoming-message webhook.

telethon_plus_url.title: telethon-plus server URL
telethon_plus_url.description: Base URL of your running docker-telethon-plus server (TELETHON_PLUS_URL), e.g. http://localhost:8080

telethon_auth_key.title: telethon-plus auth key
telethon_auth_key.description: Bearer token (TELETHON_AUTH_KEY). Only needed if the server was started with authentication enabled.
